title: Manga
subtitle: Read your manga in Japanese, with mokuro text and dictionary lookups.
loadFailed: Could not load the manga library

grid.title: Series
grid.textHint: Has text you can hover and look up
grid.nothingFound: No manga in your folders yet
grid.nothingFoundBody: Image folders, CBZ and ZIP files count as volumes, and the folder they are in as the series. Add files and rescan.

detail.gone: This series is no longer in the library
detail.goneBody: Its folder was removed or moved. Rescan or add the folder again.
detail.linkHint: Linking tells NihongoTracker which manga you are reading.

folders.title: Library folders
folders.body: Every folder here is scanned for series. Each subfolder with volumes is a series.
folders.removeHint: Removing a folder only forgets it here: no file is deleted.

empty.title: Your manga shelf is empty
empty.body: Add manga from your computer or a WebDAV server to read it with hover lookups. Your progress stays on this computer.

local.title: A folder on this computer
local.body: Folders of images, CBZ or ZIP volumes, and the .mokuro files that give them text.

webdav.title: A WebDAV server
webdav.body: Your own server with volumes and their .mokuro files, read on demand.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.body: Online sources through a local Suwayomi server, only if you choose to install it.

empty.tip: Tip: put each series in its own folder. A file called Vol 1.mokuro next to Vol 1.cbz or a Vol 1 folder gives that volume its text.

errors.notAFolder: That is not a folder this app can read.
errors.alreadyAdded: That folder, or one that contains it, is already in the library.

toast.addedEmpty: Folder added, but no manga was found in it yet

servers.title: WebDAV servers
servers.body: Series on these servers are listed in your library and read on demand: nothing is downloaded until you open a volume.
servers.removeHint: Removing a server only forgets it here, with its downloads: nothing on the server changes.

status.offline: Offline: showing what was seen last

form.title: Connect a WebDAV server
form.body: Any WebDAV server with your volumes works, including a mokuro-bunko server. Series are listed from its mokuro-reader folder when it has one.
form.urlHint: The folder with your series, or the server root. http:// or https://.
form.name: Name
form.keepHint: Leave these empty to keep the credentials already saved.
form.foundBunko: In {{path}}, the way mokuro-bunko serves it.
form.privacy: Credentials stay on this computer: they are only sent to this server and are never shown again.

empty.title: No servers yet
empty.body: Connect a WebDAV server to read its volumes and their .mokuro text without downloading them first.
empty.noSeries: No series on your servers yet
empty.noSeriesBody: Each folder on the server is a series. They appear here as soon as the server has been listed.

errors.offline: The server could not be reached. Check the address and your connection.
errors.unauthorized: The server refused the user, password or token.
errors.not-found: That folder does not exist on the server.
errors.not-webdav: That address does not answer like a WebDAV server.
errors.needs-download: This server does not send parts of files: the volume has to be downloaded to be read.
errors.too-large: The server sent more than expected.
errors.changed: The file changed on the server. Sync and try again.
errors.invalid-url: Enter a full http:// or https:// address.
errors.error: The server answered with an error.

toast.downloadingToRead: This server cannot send parts of files: downloading the volume to read it…

download.downloadedHint: Downloaded: it can be read without the server
download.offline: The server is offline and this volume is not downloaded

detail.layerHint: Alternative texts from the server (.mokuro layers)
detail.offlineBody: Downloaded volumes can still be read. The rest come back when the server does.

variant.int8Hint: Recommended. Compact, fast on any computer.
variant.fp16Hint: Larger weights, a little more faithful. Slower on the CPU.

install.title: Download the OCR
install.intro: The OCR reads the text of pages that have no .mokuro. It runs on this computer: pages are never uploaded anywhere. It needs these files, downloaded once:
install.noRoom: There may not be enough free space for the download.
install.privacy: Every file is checked against its SHA-256 before it is kept. Runs on the CPU.
install.privacy_directml: Every file is checked against its SHA-256 before it is kept. Uses the GPU through DirectML when it can, the CPU otherwise.
install.privacy_coreml: Every file is checked against its SHA-256 before it is kept. Uses CoreML when it can, the CPU otherwise.
install.background: You can close this window: the download goes on and Settings shows how it goes.
install.resumes: What already came down is kept: the download picks up where it stopped.
install.doneBody: Pages without text can be read now, from the reader or with “Read text” on each volume.

toast.nothingToRead: Every page of this volume already has text.

errors.unsupported: There is no ONNX Runtime build for this computer, so the built-in OCR cannot run here.
errors.not-installed: The OCR is not installed yet.
errors.offline: The download stopped: no connection. Try again later; it resumes where it stopped.
errors.server: The server did not send the file. Try again later.
errors.checksum: A downloaded file was not the expected one and was deleted. Try again.
errors.disk: The file could not be saved. Check the free space.
errors.unreadable: The page image could not be read.
errors.not-found: This page is no longer in the library.
errors.no-text: This volume has no text to export yet.
errors.read-only: The server does not let this account write there.
errors.changed: The file changed on the server meanwhile. Try again.
errors.not-local: This volume is not a folder or archive on this computer.
errors.not-remote: This volume is not on a WebDAV server.
errors.bad-size: The page's size is not known yet. Wait for it to load and try again.
errors.too-many: Too many boxes on one page.

volume.processHint: Read the text of every page without it, in the background. A notification says when it is done.
volume.installHint: Download the built-in OCR to read the text of this volume.

export.title: Export as .mokuro
export.body: Writes the volume's text (mokuro's, the OCR's and your corrections) as a .mokuro file next to the volume, so Mokuro Reader and other readers can use it.
export.bodyRemote: Uploads the volume's text (mokuro's, the OCR's and your corrections) as a .mokuro file next to the volume on the server, so Mokuro Reader and other clients of that server can use it.
export.permission: This writes to the server: your account there needs permission to write. Nothing else on the server is changed.
export.exists: There is already a .mokuro next to this volume. Replace it with this one?
export.existsRemote: The server already has a .mokuro for this volume. Replace it with this one? It is only replaced if nobody changed it since.
